core_principles: Emotion: Appetite Appeal (Mobile) vs Calm Efficiency (KDS)
Typography: Serif for flavor, Mono for data
anti_patterns: No boring list views without images
No stark white backgrounds (#FFFFFF) - use Bone/Cream

usage_rules.h1_hero: font-serif text-4xl md:text-6xl font-medium tracking-tight leading-none
usage_rules.h2_section: font-serif text-2xl md:text-3xl font-normal tracking-tight text-primary

grids.kds_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5 gap-4

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-12 px-8 rounded-full font-medium transition-transform active:scale-95 shadow-lg
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 h-12 px-6 rounded-full font-medium
buttons.outline: border-2 border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary/5 h-12 px-6 rounded-full font-medium
buttons.kds_action: h-14 w-full rounded-none font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-widest

cards.menu_item: group relative overflow-hidden bg-card border border-transparent hover:border-border transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-xl rounded-xl
cards.kds_ticket: bg-card border-l-4 flex flex-col h-full rounded-r-md shadow-sm

navigation.mobile_bottom_bar: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-border p-4 z-50 pb-safe
navigation.kds_header: bg-slate-900 border-b border-slate-800 p-4 flex justify-between items-center text-white

textures.noise: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noiseFilter'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.65' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noiseFilter)' opacity='0.05'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")

image_assets.strategy: High-fidelity food photography. Warm lighting. Close-ups.

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure text overlay on food images has a 'bg-black/40' scrim or gradient.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44px for all mobile interactive elements.
accessibility.kds_readability: High contrast text for kitchen environments (smoke, grease, distance).

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not use gradients for the KDS background, use solid dark colors.
For the Customer App, use the 'Sage Green' (#5A6B5D) as the primary brand color by default.
Implement 'Sonner' for all toast notifications (Order placed, Kitchen updates).
Use 'Framer Motion' for the mobile menu: Staggered list entrance, shared layout transition for category switching.
KDS tickets must have a 'Time Elapsed' counter that changes color (Green -> Yellow -> Red) as time passes.
Never use 'Inter' for Headings. Use 'Playfair Display'.
For mobile inputs (modifiers), use bottom sheets (Drawers) instead of center modals.
All images must have alt text describing the food.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons and inputs.

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Update tailwind.config.js with the new color palette (Light for App, Dark for KDS) and fonts.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Create a 'Layout' component that handles the switching between 'Customer Theme' and 'Kitchen Theme' based on the route.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Build the 'MenuCategory' component as a horizontal scrollable pill list.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Build the 'MenuItem' component with the image taking up the top half (or left side on desktop) and proper typography.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_6: Implement the KDS board using a CSS Grid that auto-fills based on screen width.
